title: Cumulative human cells replaced over 100 days

source.name: Cell replacement rate research
source.publisher: Peer-reviewed cell biology studies, as compiled by Scientific American

notes: About 330 billion human cells are replaced daily (roughly 1% of all cells in the body); cumulatively that reaches about 30 trillion replaced cells -- equivalent to a full cellular replacement -- within 80 to 100 days. Interior points are a straight-line approximation of the daily rate.
